about: A double battle goes on beside an empty first place: Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with two Pokemon, a level-3 Sentret leading and a level-7 Rattata. The Sentret, given poison and 1 HP in the running battle (set:), faints in the first turn with no one to take its place while the Rattata protects; then the Rattata, holding a Focus Sash, Quick Attacks foes left at 1 HP and levels up more than once. gym.py's player ends the first turn at the Rattata's command, the only one asked, and moves each level-up on with B. Before, fight:1:1 waited for a command from the empty place, and with that fixed alone the first 'grew to' still waited out the run's frames, the party menu's branch taken with no one to send.
